core_obligations: Preserve the assumption that the target function has no circuit of size s.
Retain complete author circuit-monomial enumeration and O(s)-degree sum identity.
Retain every gate-type evaluation case and final negative-monomial refutation derivation.
difficulty_reason: The authors construct circuit monomials encoding every circuit structure, derive their sum equals one in linear degree, and derive the negative of each circuit monomial by evaluating that fixed circuit on an input contradicting the target truth table. Summing these derivations yields an explicit linear-degree SoS refutation despite quadratically many structure variables.

dedup.scope: Root DOI/arxiv/ECCC source lookup zero neighbors. This constructive O(s)-degree refutation upper bound is independent of expander-based lower bounds and has a full separate author proof. It is not a direct consequence of the lower-bound results.
